t1_semantics.rank: zero-based rank in descending actual selected gate weight, stable ties; ranks 4..7 correspond to paper ranks 5..8
t1_semantics.scope: all routed layers, decode only; prefill unchanged
t1_semantics.normalization: preserve the loaded model router normalization contract
t1_semantics.estimand: whole-model quality consequence of repeatedly applying this one bin-specific policy across decode layers and steps
t1_semantics.not_claimed: an isolated layer/event delta, an additive rank decomposition, or safe quality from a zero-event cell
t1_semantics.gate_coverage: bins cover [0, 0.2); gates >= 0.2 are not included
t1_semantics.backend: torch for the initial quality diagnostic; no latency claim

scope: teacher-forced selected decode windows; no timing or task-accuracy claim
aggregation: exp(sum token NLL / scored decode tokens); position zero excluded
kl_direction: KL(native || policy), full vocabulary, before forcing mask
normalization: preserve each installed router's renormalize flag and routing scale; decision gate fractions are normalized separately
